players.product: MBE-grown InP PIN / APD photodetector epiwafers for 100G-200G data-center optical transceivers, plus GaAs VCSEL / pHEMT and InP HBT epiwafers

quarterly_data.signal: Q1 2026 results deck (May 7, 2026): revenue NTD 332,151 thousand, up 22.8% YoY and 4.3% QoQ; gross profit NTD 158,905 thousand (gross margin 47.8%); operating income NTD 96,545 thousand; net income NTD 78,693 thousand; basic EPS NTD 1.97. By application, fiber-optic networks were 45.1% of Q1 2026 sales, high-speed transmission devices 12.3% and hardware components 22.1%.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 2026 revenue NTD 332,151 thousand (+22.8% YoY, +4.3% QoQ); gross margin 47.8%; operating income NTD 96,545 thousand; EPS NTD 1.97; fiber-optic networks 45.1%

quarterly_data.signal: Deck (operating strategy, InP): demand from AI optical-communication majors for PIN epiwafers keeps increasing and mass-production orders are in place, with company capacity fully prepared, but insufficient InP substrate supply is the main bottleneck; production runs in parallel on company-supplied InP substrates and customer-supplied substrates, customers can now accept qualification of different substrate makers, and the company will keep working with the majors to secure more substrate supply.

Deck (operating strategy, GaAs): price-adjustment negotiations with major customers are completed and the main customers' 2026 pHEMT mass-production orders have been obtained, with the focus now on quality and efficiency; quantum-dot (QD) laser epiwafer development is progressing normally in cooperation with customers.
